slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,706 today, down 0.76%, as the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.11%, its highest level in roughly 19 years. When government borrowing costs rise that fast, investors often sell stocks because safe bonds suddenly look more attractive. Small company stocks got hit hardest, the Russell 2000 fell 1.28%. Gold, oil, bitcoin, and crypto all sold off together, which is unusual and signals broad nervousness rather than a simple rotation. Jobless claims are due Thursday and could move markets if they surprise.
